purpose: Teach: 精通/バネ/急上昇/弁理/全編/特段/ジャッジ/発進

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、業界に精通された
lines.en: When Dad founded the company, he really knew the industry inside and out.
lines.style: Gentle, measured opening. The voice of someone reflecting on the past with quiet reverence. Slow pace, letting each phrase settle. Warm and present — no performance, just remembrance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはバネのある経営判断をされた
lines.en: Yes. Dad always made decisive business judgments — there was real elasticity to his thinking.
lines.style: Affirmative but grounded. Not praising from a distance — speaking from lived example. Steady tone, each phrase weighted. The voice of someone still learning from what his father did.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業績急上昇期にも謙虚さを保たれた
lines.en: Even during those years when everything was going up so fast, he stayed humble about it.
lines.style: Soft admiration underneath. A slight pause before the key point. The voice slightly thins — this humility is something he values, perhaps misses. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは特許戦略で弁理士と組まれた
lines.en: Yes. Dad was very strategic about patents — he knew to partner with the right lawyers.
lines.style: Factual foundation, but the warmth is in the precision. Speaking of a man who thought carefully. Even tone — respect expressed through accuracy, not emotion. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社史の全編を監修された
lines.en: Dad personally oversaw the entire company history — made sure it was documented properly.
lines.style: Quieter now. The specificity of 'entire' carries weight — this was something he cared about personally. A slight fade at the end, like holding something precious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは特段の事情がある社員に配慮された
lines.en: Yes. Dad was always careful with the employees who had particular circumstances — he looked out for them.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact, but the care underneath is unmissable. Not sentimental — just factual kindness. The voice holds its ground, speaks from principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員のジャッジを公平にされた
lines.en: He judged people fairly — that was one of his principles.
lines.style: Quiet, almost meditative. The simplicity here is intentional. A man who values justice speaking of justice. The pace slows; this mattered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新規事業の発進を決断された
lines.en: Yes. And he made the final call to launch the new business — that took real vision.
lines.style: Full circle. Quieter, almost a closing reflection. The voice settles into something final. Warm, steady, the kind of tone that honors a complete life. No rush.
